newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates drop, forint seen easing vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates drop, forint seen easing vs dlr.

text.p: 0630 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates opened at Thursday's closing levels of 20.375 percent and edged down to 20 percent on abundant market liquidity, dealers said on Friday.
* They said funds which flowed into one-week reverse repo deals at 20.25 percent one week ago, when overnight rates were as low as 18 percent, were returning to the interbank market.
* The forint was seen opening at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid), which stood at 188.22, slightly down from Thursday's close of 188.14/19.
* The forint was seen tracking the dollar/mark cross.
